gloss: let alone; much less; still more

definitions.gloss: let alone; much less; to say nothing of
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that if something is difficult or true for one situation, it is even more so for a more extreme situation. Often used with negative statements.
Used to emphasize that something applies even more strongly to what follows.

examples.japanese: まして⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ。
⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、まして⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ。
examples.english: It's difficult even for adults, let alone children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。まして⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧さえ⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ましてや⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|むずか}しすぎる。

examples.japanese: ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、まして⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's already tough domestically, and overseas the problems become even more numerous.

⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧すら⟦{裏切|うらぎ}る→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。まして⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ならなおさらだ。

examples.english: It's crowded even on nice days. All the more so during holiday periods, it's terribly packed.

examples.english: I'm busy even normally, and even more so at year's end — I don't have time to rest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験者|けいけんしゃ}→経験者：18664_keikensha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}する→苦労する：25357_kurousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、まして⟦{未経験者|みけいけんしゃ}→未経験者：26291_mikeikensha⟧ならなおさら⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Even experienced people struggle with it, so it would take even longer for someone with no experience.

notes:
FORMS:
- ましてや - emphatic form (let alone, much less)
ましてや is more emphatic and commonly used in modern speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Typically appears in structure:
[A ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧/すら X]、まして[B ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧/なら なおさら Y]
(Even A can't do X, let alone B can't do Y)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まして〜⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧ - let alone doing ~
- まして〜⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧ - let alone ~ (and so on)
- まして〜ならなおさら - still more so if ~

USAGE:
- Often follows statements with ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧, すら, さえ (even)
- Usually connects to negative or emphatic statements
- Written in hiragana; not typically written in kanji

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いわんや - much less, not to mention (literary)
- なおさら - all the more
- ⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧ - of course, needless to say

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
